scenarios.title: Roller II Ctrl fire and Enter high-score confirmation
scenarios.description: Complete original game execution with a declared zero-score input file so the natural 299-point run qualifies. Both Ctrl keys fire, Ctrl+arrows combine, and unmapped shortcuts stay outside AMOS. Real keyboard input types and confirms a name with Enter; the original code saves Highscores, returns to the menu and starts a fresh game. No VM variable/IP edits or native capture.

scenarios.title: Roller II help pages and menu return
scenarios.description: The complete current AMOS source runs all seven help icon pages and the original timed colour/ball examples, then returns to the menu. Line 1129 has a source-level final-page offset fix; compiler cursor bounds remain strict. Four independent raw-asset icon regions and nine actual GPU/CPU frame comparisons. Input-only replay, not an Amiga capture.

scenarios.title: Application debug menu and binary file downloads
scenarios.description: Normal and --debug page-builder examples: accessible icon controls, AMOS Bsave exports of new/modified files, exact binary bytes, compact errors, source logs and owned download URL cleanup. The examples below remain playable after checks.

scenarios.title: Optimized scalar instruction blocks
scenarios.description: Compare reference and opt-in optimized standalone modules across nine instruction budgets, preserving typed values, source locations and original instruction counts. This is a semantic comparison, not a browser performance benchmark.

scenarios.title: Game page tutorial, Latin-1 font and touch joystick
scenarios.description: Independent umlaut glyph pixels, real GPU text, multi-pointer cross controls, keyboard/Gamepad merging and owned input cleanup. Includes a fully generated playable HTML example with sound, fullscreen and touch settings.

scenarios.title: Roller II Edit host boundary
scenarios.description: Original ROUNDTURN rotates four directions and reaches its Edit fallback for prepared zero/diagonal inputs. Twelve vector-oracle Canvas frames, four GPU comparisons and two post-cleanup editor requests; fullscreen and Restart. PHALT/movement are guarded; no embedded editor.

scenarios.title: Roller II paired high-score sorting
scenarios.description: Original defaults, insertion and integer/string Swap sort all eleven score/name pairs. Five prepared entries match fifteen independent Canvas images and three GPU frames; editable score/name, fullscreen and Restart. Portable preview; source name entry, persistence and menu return excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II rainbow deletion
scenarios.description: Original line 557 deletes rainbow 0 after a declared HOPSCREEN guard. Overlapping prepared PAL tables reveal slot 1, then delete-all restores the screen palette. Three independent Canvas images/three GPU frames, fullscreen and Restart; bounce/editor return excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II Get Icon requesters
scenarios.description: Original missing-level and overwrite prompt captures on a prepared striped screen. Six independent Canvas images and six GPU frames verify exclusive bounds, padded icon 118 and masked restore. Declared requester guards; fullscreen and Restart, with editor/persistence excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II mouse pointer shapes
scenarios.description: Seven original Change Mouse statements select browser arrow/crosshair/wait cursors. Canvas/WebGL ownership, Hide/Show nesting and program switching are checked, with seven GPU comparisons. Prepared hover surface; editor actions and native pointer pixels excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II screen under pointer
scenarios.description: Original pointer-selection lines on declared overlapping windows. Seven Canvas stripe-oracle frames, seven GPU comparisons and pointer mapping on both hosts; live coordinate/zone readout, fullscreen and Restart. Editor scrolling/actions excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II Writing text modes
scenarios.description: Original Writing 0,2 label statement, a pen-only background proof and all fifteen mode/part combinations. Four independent Canvas images and four GPU comparisons; fullscreen and Restart. Prepared blank preview with portable font; editor loop excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II patterned selection border
scenarios.description: Original Set Line/Box selection, erase and redraw on a declared blank preview with the original palette. Three independent Canvas frames and three GPU comparisons; clipped edge-cell controls, fullscreen and Restart. Editor panel/Writing/game loop are excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II editor memory transfers
scenarios.description: Original editor Fill/Copy statements back up, clear and restore all fifteen real level payloads. Tile/colour bytes change while metadata, allocations and backup remain intact; restore waits at a declared redraw guard. Live in-memory preview without persistence or editor/game loops.

scenarios.title: Roller II original arrow movement
scenarios.description: Original PFEIL/N34 after real level progression: one-pixel arrow steps and down/up/left turns, native timeout Boom, pause and source bank integrity. Twenty independent Canvas images/ten GPU comparisons over keyboard/Gamepad paths; remaining obstacle and game-over handlers stay guarded.

scenarios.title: Synthesized AMOS Boom
scenarios.description: Original four pitches, shared field-mutated noise and integer EnvBoom rendered as finite PCM with explicit portable beam/phase choices. Five independent native Web Audio stereo comparisons, Stop/disposal and gesture-controlled audition. Exact DMA/beam capture parity remains open.

scenarios.title: Roller II original pause modes
scenarios.description: Original PAUSE/IPause after real level progression: mouse/Help paid pause, Space pause popup, keyboard/Gamepad WTIN return and source Timer restoration. Twenty independent Canvas images and ten GPU comparisons; live fullscreen/Stop/Resume/Restart. Enter is joystick fire so Space reaches AMOS. Arrows and game-over remain guarded.

scenarios.title: Roller II bonus and next level
scenarios.description: Original five-tile collection continues through ZAEHLHOCH inclusive bonus scoring, Return and LEVLOAD into the real second-level bank, ready prompt and starting ball. Fourteen independent Canvas images and seven GPU comparisons using keyboard/Gamepad. Other obstacle/pause/game-over handlers remain guarded.

scenarios.title: Roller II original colour collections
scenarios.description: Original KCWEG/BCL/GAMED collect all five first-level colour tiles, update exact map bytes, score and remaining count, and fade only the ball palette. Fourteen independent Canvas images and seven WebGL comparisons across keyboard/Gamepad input; bonus scoring/level loading remains guarded.

scenarios.title: Roller II original floor movement
scenarios.description: Original string-based SAS$ dispatch, wall checks and floor sliding on level 1. Keyboard and browser Gamepad paths verify 48 field positions, twelve independent Canvas frames and six WebGL comparisons; the colour handler remains guarded. Live fullscreen/Stop/Resume/Restart preview.

scenarios.title: Roller II original game input loop
scenarios.description: Connected original setup and JOAB through 639: real countdown, physical Key State, keyboard/Gamepad directions, effects/music keys and Escape menu return. Twenty-four independent Canvas checks and six WebGL frames; movement, pause and game-over handlers are guarded.

scenarios.title: Roller II ready prompt and initial ball
scenarios.description: Connected original startup/menu, game setup, GAMEDISP and blinking foreground ready prompt through line 617. Original ball palette, six-plane sprite, fade and status border; independent pixels, eighteen Canvas checks and six WebGL frames. Mouse, keyboard and Gamepad fire reach the guard before movement; live fullscreen preview.

scenarios.title: Roller II original board rendering
scenarios.description: Unchanged GAMEDISP across all fifteen supplied maps, with original icon copies, retained masks and source tile counts. Independent board PNGs, sixteen Canvas checks and two WebGL frames. Live level selector/fullscreen preview; palette restoration is a declared harness and the full prompt/gameplay path remains excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II raw icon memory and ICCOPY
scenarios.description: Original game-entry icon copies through checked planar aliases, including rounded padding and unchanged masks. Independent before/after pixels and two WebGL frames; live Copy/Reset/fullscreen inspector. Game screen and level setup remain excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II level metadata and word memory
scenarios.description: Original metadata reads and Doke time writes across all fifteen pinned level files, checked against independent headers. Live level/time memory preview; no file persistence, game/editor loop or rendering.

scenarios.title: Roller II intro, menu and first level load
scenarios.description: Original startup, menu and game entry now create game screens, initialize the rainbow, load level 1 and refresh status text. Ten input cases, nine guarded selections and three independent/GPU frames. WebGL/fullscreen and optional MOD music; board drawing, gameplay and editor/scores/help routines remain excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II intro, initialization and main-title image
scenarios.description: Original intro/input wait/FDZ/FLOAD, highscore and tile-handler initialization, work/icon/sprite banks, then a declared handoff to the tall EHB title load. Keyboard, pointer and injected Gamepad API input pass independent checks. Live WebGL/fullscreen preview; setup 281–286 and menu logic remain excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II first image and original FLOAD
scenarios.description: Unchanged startup through the first FLOAD, original procedure, AMSC placement, hidden palette clone and Fade To. Independent Python image pixels verify seven Canvas/copper states and seven WebGL comparisons. Live fullscreen preview precedes WTIN, the main title and gameplay.

scenarios.title: Roller II original startup
scenarios.description: Unmodified first 17 lines execute Set Stack/Break Off, Dir$, TRUE, original sample/tracker loads and Hide. Step/reset controls inspect the silent field clock; native Canvas checks cover nested Hide/Show. The captured default screen precedes FLOAD; title rendering and gameplay remain open.

scenarios.title: Tunnel animation
scenarios.description: Original Tunneltest program with its supplied icon bank and IFF background. Watch the animation, step frames, use fullscreen or choose an IFF background. Independent checks cover 48 frames and all 24 wheel images.

scenarios.title: Play the complete original Roller II program
scenarios.description: Source-corrected game with current supplied assets: original intro/menu, level-1 colours and warp into level 3, bottom-right time bonus and safe edge bump, host Stop/Timer expiry, game-over screen/music, restored score image, menu return and a fresh game. Keyboard/Gamepad, independent image regions, actual WebGL and a live fullscreen/audio host. Editor entry, overlapping windows, tile placement and level testing/return with the animated panel are also checked. Remaining levels, editor file actions and win paths are not yet accepted.

scenarios.title: Roller II VM end music and volume fade
scenarios.description: Original Music/Mvolume/Music Off statements run standalone with driver-owned VBL wakes. Full first-wrap PAL/NTSC traces, source fade/erase, Stop/Resume and owned browser audio; end-state graphics remain excluded.

scenarios.title: Roller II AMOS Music end tunes
scenarios.description: Direct field-stepped playback of Over.mus and Ywon.mus; independent full-cycle PAL/NTSC traces and 25 native Web Audio instrument comparisons. Separate direct-player foundation; the VM demo adds command/lifecycle integration.

scenarios.title: Play Roller II MOD music
scenarios.description: Original bounded load/Led Off/Track Play statements run in a compiled VM, with independent field wakes, Pause/Resume and Stop. All 1,997 notes and ten instrument waveforms pass source-derived/native Web Audio checks. Full-game integration remains open.

scenarios.title: Roller II target and MOD inspector
scenarios.description: Original sample/Track Load statements execute with explicit fixture boundaries. A bounded M.K. reader decodes the original module, instruments and effects. The separate music demo runs compiled Track Play; the whole source now compiles, while full-game execution remains open.

scenarios.title: Play unmodified Wonderland
scenarios.description: The complete original game with default WebGL2 presentation, selectable Canvas 2D, fullscreen, keyboard/Gamepad controls, Stop/Resume and Restart. Input-only keyboard and injected-gamepad replays render three deaths/fades, two life restarts, game over and a fresh game. Enable/Mute controls route original sample commands through Web Audio; three native offline PCM/stereo comparisons cover the replay. No Amiga capture or persistent editor files are claimed.

scenarios.title: Fsel$ and unmodified Wonderland game entry
scenarios.description: Prepared synchronous file choices execute the original retry/Gosub/Return routine and selected load/save calls. The unmodified complete program runs and renders four first-level frames over two controlled seconds, including attached sprites and rainbow/HUD scheduling. No native selector GUI or complete gameplay parity is claimed.

scenarios.title: AMOS Rnd and original enemy initialization
scenarios.description: Source-derived seeded PRNG vectors and eighteen original blob/green-jump streams with controlled beam input. Includes step/reset/cache controls; gameplay, native startup seeds and real beam timing remain outside this data fixture.

scenarios.title: Wonderland raw level-file save/load
scenarios.description: Original map writeback, Bsave, Bload and seed-refresh statements round-trip all five maps through an in-memory files adapter. Exact exclusive-end bytes, stable addresses and retained fifth seed are checked. Includes cell editing, raw download and optional local preload; file selection and gameplay are excluded.

scenarios.title: AMOS hardware mouse and original game input
scenarios.description: Hardware-coordinate input, original mouse limits, polling-based Mouse Click and X/Y Mouse assignment. Original Wonderland editor selection and fourteen Roller II joystick mouse steps pass through keyboard and injected Gamepad API input. Includes a live editor button-selection harness; game actions remain excluded.

scenarios.title: Wonderland editor panel zones
scenarios.description: Original five-button zone definitions and the original Zone expression classify all 10,240 panel positions with injected hardware coordinates. Independent panel PNG comparison and a live point/reset inspector; mouse clicks/limits and editor actions remain excluded.

scenarios.title: AMOS Flash and screen-local Flash Off
scenarios.description: Clocked colour cycles, selected-screen cancellation, unchanged physical pixels and immutable snapshots. Normal/EHB/HAM6 Canvas and CPU output use independent RGB expectations. Includes live Stop/Resume/Flash Off controls; Screen Open implicit flashing remains unsupported.

scenarios.title: Wonderland: publish all five level maps
scenarios.description: Original level-data and Paste Bob loops build five hidden maps, then Screen Copy Logic To Physic publishes their full bitmaps without swapping. Includes a clock-stepped map demo and host scrolling inspection. Gameplay remains excluded.

scenarios.title: Wonderland score fields and Print Using
scenarios.description: Original level/score statements, integer padding/truncation and five panel frames checked against a separate glyph rasterizer over independent image PNGs. Includes a compiled integer-field sandbox. Floats and decimal/exponent masks remain unsupported.

scenarios.title: Wonderland Fade and VBL palette timing
scenarios.description: Original title setup and post-death Fade 2 / Wait 64 / Wait Vbl lines, with declared trigger/exit guards. Nine independent RGB comparisons, immutable snapshots, unchanged physical pixels and clock-driven palette updates. Includes live Fade/Stop/Resume/Restart controls.

scenarios.title: AMOS scan codes and Wonderland Escape
scenarios.description: Inkey$/Scancode consumption, physical key mappings, repeats, joystick passthrough and lifecycle cleanup. Runs the original Wonderland input/Escape branch and title routine in a declared fixture. Includes a live compiled keyboard reader.

scenarios.title: Computed branches and Wonderland initialization
scenarios.description: One-based On Gosub/Goto, out-of-range fallthrough and return traces. Executes Wonderland's original dispatch line and three unchanged initializers; the other two targets have explicit End guards. Synthetic inputs and image captions; no enemy gameplay.

scenarios.title: Wonderland screen windows and scrolling
scenarios.description: Original game/editor screen setup, physical-buffer scrolling, independent landscape/panel PNG checks, two blank rows and staged View commits. The complete game is not running.

scenarios.title: Wonderland menu: keyboard and gamepad
scenarios.description: Original menu routines with animated movement, background toggle and mode selection. Choose keyboard mapping, Gamepad API or both in the live menu below. Stops before unsupported gameplay/editor dispatch.

scenarios.title: AMOS keyboard repeat and cleanup
scenarios.description: Source-compiled Key Speed, controlled 200/40 ms repeats, ignored native duplicates and keyup/blur/Stop/detach/End cleanup. Includes a focused live keyboard demo.

scenarios.title: Wonderland samples and Web Audio
scenarios.description: Six original PCM samples, independent offline stereo/rate comparisons, loops, replacement and Stop/disposal checks. Explicit buttons audition each sample.

scenarios.title: Wonderland milestone: original title screen
scenarios.description: Original 64-line title setup executes through Wait Vbl, image loading and its menu marker Bob. Both startup branches match an independent source-derived image. The menu loop and game are not running yet.

scenarios.title: WebGL2 integer readback
scenarios.description: Exact chip bytes, unsigned addressing, integer framebuffer and PNG decoding.

scenarios.title: GPU uploads and context restoration
scenarios.description: All chip sizes and ABI tables, dirty rows, independent consumers, loss/restore and disposal.

scenarios.title: GPU / CPU rendering gallery
scenarios.description: Independent IFF images, scroll and sprite matrices, copper stacks, 100 seeded frames, GPU presentation/aspect scaling and restored shaders.

scenarios.title: Sprite DMA and channel reuse
scenarios.description: Chained descriptors, blank control lines, held rows and native Canvas pixels.

scenarios.title: BobTest: 64 bouncing Bobs
scenarios.description: The unchanged BobTest.amos draws and captures its three images, bounces 64 objects for 500 frames, restores the grid and ends after a second key. Live WebGL/Canvas, pause, restart and fullscreen. Configured for 65 Bob slots because the source uses IDs 1–64. Portable circle raster and zero startup random seed/beam; source has no frame wait and is not a native speed benchmark. Checks verify independent image/path/composite expectations and eight actual GPU frames.

scenarios.title: Planet Zybex: background and score preview
scenarios.description: First milestone toward a playable Planet Zybex showcase. The seven original packed level banks decode through the original Load/Unpack statements; 35 scrolled windows match independent pixels and actual WebGL output. The original score updates also run in a declared fixture: the hires strip and lowres playfield match four independent frames and GPU output. The original Default/Screen Close/Close Editor startup prefix also runs through declared key guards, with two GPU frames and owned display clearing. The full game still needs sprite-buffer allocation, AMAL, computed/wide sprites and update control. This is a presentation preview, not gameplay.

scenarios.title: Roller II intro: sliding screen windows
scenarios.description: Both unchanged RolIntrIdee2 sources slide cropped screens from above and below the display. All 200 PAL/NTSC movement frames match independent ILBM and raster-crop expectations, with 28 actual GPU comparisons, pointer checks and Stop/Resume. Includes live playback with optional original sample sound; no native capture is claimed.

scenarios.title: Open Port: original printer programs
scenarios.description: Run three unchanged Introideen printer programs through an explicit parallel-output capture. All 5,661 bytes match independently transcribed expectations, including escape codes, tabs and high characters. Download raw .prn files and inspect their hexadecimal bytes. No printer driver or physical printing is emulated.

scenarios.title: ANIM-5 and the original Logoanim intro
scenarios.description: All twenty asset frames match independent Python history/bitplane expectations. Both unchanged Logoanim sources load/play eighteen frames through ordinary bank addresses and swaps, continue their logo-copy sequence and finish through mouse input. Includes Stop/Resume and actual GPU comparisons; no native Amiga capture is claimed.

scenarios.title: Polygon: sphere animation generator
scenarios.description: Solid polygons with independently checked interiors/boundaries, plus the unchanged backup sphere generator. All eight exported IFFs match their rendered pixels and are downloadable below. The portable raster profile is documented; native AreaEnd edge parity remains unverified.

scenarios.title: Save Iff: render, save and download a sphere
scenarios.description: The unchanged KugelanimBerech program renders its sphere and saves rollerball after a real Canvas key event. An independent decoder checks all saved pixels; a separate Load Iff preview and two actual GPU comparisons verify presentation. Download the generated IFF from the Debug menu below. Session files are volatile.

scenarios.title: Roller II intro idea: Zoom animation
scenarios.description: The unchanged 49-line RollerIIIntroIdee program and its supplied R.abk asset. Sixteen generated icons and all 29 animation frames match independent Python expectations; four Canvas/GPU frames are compared. Select captured frames to inspect the original animation.

scenarios.title: Sqr and the original Kugel shading program
scenarios.description: Exact FFP square roots, independently checked grayscale tiles and the unchanged Kugel sphere program. The original source stops when its shading expression produces colour -1; the retained partial sphere is not a completed rendering. Two actual GPU/CPU comparisons.

scenarios.title: Trigonometry and angle modes
scenarios.description: Source-compiled Sin/Cos/Tan, degree/radian modes and matching Canvas/planar/copper pixels.

scenarios.title: Extra Half Brite
scenarios.description: Six-bit pixel codes, masked palette registers and exact four-bit halving.

scenarios.title: HAM6 colour history
scenarios.description: Palette and component commands, row resets, independent factories and three matching output paths.

scenarios.title: Direct sprites and manual updates
scenarios.description: Frozen/pending positions, movement, hiding, palette priority, mouse reservation and cursor restoration.

scenarios.title: Banks, buffers and Bobs
scenarios.description: External load/save/reload, appending, swaps, reservation, shrinking, erasure and saved Bob backgrounds.

scenarios.title: Interactive programs, input and lifecycle
scenarios.description: Control flow, graphics, image banks, Bobs/collisions, keyboard/mouse, switching and Stop.

scenarios.title: Roller II — full game with debug enabled
scenarios.description: The full current game and assets with a Debug menu for downloading modified session files and inspecting source errors. Play retains the original intro; no verification replay is required.
